mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_workflow_run (meeting_id, template_id, template_key, current_stage_key, current_stage_order, status, blocked_reason, reopen_count) VALUES (#{meetingId}, #{templateId}, #{templateKey}, #{currentStageKey}, #{currentStageOrder}, #{status}, #{blockedReason}, #{reopenCount})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_workflow_run WHERE meeting_id = #{meetingId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_workflow_run SET status = #{status}, blocked_reason = #{blockedReason}, gmt_modify = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE ai_workflow_run SET current_stage_key = #{currentStageKey}, current_stage_order = #{currentStageOrder}, gmt_modify = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE ai_workflow_run SET reopen_count = reopen_count + 1, gmt_modify = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
